summary: One request reopened people's ended lines in a campaign on the person's decision: the line counts what happened to its items, names the people enrolled again, and, where a run carried the decision, the question whose answer it was.

reopened.description: Items that enrolled a member whose line was ended again.

not_finished.description: Items naming a member whose line was not ended: enrolled, or paused.

not_member.description: Items naming a person the campaign never held.

excluded.description: Items naming a person removed from the campaign.

not_in_decision.description: Items naming a person the ended line the question is about does not name, or whose line a later contacts_finished line ended again.

rejected.description: Items refused, each answered with its error in the response.

contact_ids.description: The people enrolled again, in the order of the request; empty when nobody was.

decision_id.description: The question a named person answered about the ended line, where a run carried the decision; null where the person's own word reopened it.
